outlook.summary: Not financial advice — this is a personal tracking dashboard meant to organize publicly available information for research purposes. Always size positions and confirm with your own research.

strongest.area: Enterprise and AI software, led by Salesforce, ServiceNow and Adobe
strongest.reason: guidance raises and product news (including Salesforce's new AI push) reinforced the 'AI isn't eating software' narrative and lifted the group broadly over the past week, with the rally still holding

strongest.area: AI chip design tools, led by Cadence and Synopsys
strongest.reason: both posted strong quarters and raised full-year guidance on resilient AI chip design demand — Cadence's backlog hit a record $8.1B — even as the broader chip-manufacturing trade wobbled Tuesday

weakest.area: AI chip and infrastructure names, led by AMD and the broader semiconductor complex
weakest.reason: traded choppily and mostly lower Tuesday as renewed Iran-linked tanker strikes near the Strait of Hormuz and a fresh multi-month high in the 10-year yield weighed on richly-valued AI names

weakest.area: Macro-sensitive assets broadly, including mega-cap tech and gold
weakest.reason: rising Fed rate-hike odds (now seen at 25 basis points for the September 16 meeting) alongside the overnight tanker strikes pushed oil and yields higher while pressuring equities

outlook.nextStep: The overnight tanker strikes near the Strait of Hormuz are the freshest and most consequential risk factor and are probably better watched than acted on until it's clear whether the conflict stays contained. The divergence between the still-resilient AI-software and chip-design-tools trade versus the choppier, profit-taking-driven action in AI chip and infrastructure names is worth a closer look for signs of where capital rotates next.

signals.title: Two oil tankers struck overnight near the Strait of Hormuz as U.S.-Iran hostilities flare again
signals.body: A Saudi-owned and a South Korean-owned oil tanker were both hit by projectiles Monday night, reviving the Strait of Hormuz risk premium and sending Dow, S&P 500, and Nasdaq-100 futures lower Tuesday morning. Oil jumped further on the news while Treasury yields pushed to a fresh multi-month high.
signals.focus: a genuine escalation risk worth watching closely for further headlines before drawing conclusions either way

signals.title: Fed rate-hike odds firm up further as the 10-year yield hits its highest level since January 2025
signals.body: J.P. Morgan Wealth Management now expects a 25-basis-point hike at the Fed's September 15-16 meeting, with elevated oil prices adding to inflation pressure. The 10-year yield climbed to 4.79%, pressuring rate-sensitive growth stocks and crypto alike.
signals.focus: probably better watched than acted on until the Fed meeting itself provides more clarity

signals.title: AI chip design software stays resilient even as the broader chip trade wobbles
signals.body: Cadence Design Systems raised its 2026 revenue guidance to $6.26-$6.34B on a record $8.1B backlog, and Synopsys posted a Q3 beat with raised full-year guidance, both citing strong AI chip design demand, even as Nvidia, AMD, and the rest of the chip-manufacturing complex traded choppily amid Tuesday's risk-off tone.
signals.focus: worth a closer look as a sign that AI chip design demand remains resilient even when the broader semiconductor trade gets choppy

signals.title: Cybersecurity's post-earnings re-rating keeps extending
signals.body: CrowdStrike's record Q2 (revenue of $1.47B, net-new ARR of $333M) and a strong Okta report lifted the cybersecurity group broadly last week, with Zscaler and peers still trading well-bid heading into Zscaler's own September 3 earnings report.
signals.focus: worth watching whether the re-rating has legs into Zscaler's print or starts to fade

signals.title: Enterprise software's AI-adoption narrative keeps gaining traction
signals.body: Salesforce, ServiceNow, and Adobe all rallied last week on guidance raises and product news, including Salesforce's new AI-agent push, reinforcing the view that generative AI is a tailwind rather than a threat for enterprise software vendors.
signals.focus: worth a closer look for whether the rally broadens further into smaller-cap names in the group

signals.title: Robotics names stay mixed as the underlying capex story holds
signals.body: Teradyne's Q2 revenue surged 104% year-over-year with earnings up more than 300%, and the board declared a fresh dividend, while UBTECH continues consolidating after this month's China humanoid-robotics rally and Tesla extended its robotaxi-driven gains.
signals.focus: worth treating single-day swings as noise relative to the longer-term capital-flow trend into robotics and automation

signals.title: Bitcoin and Ethereum stay choppy in a tight range as rate and geopolitical risk weigh
signals.body: Both cryptocurrencies have traded in a narrow band over the past two sessions as the Fed's hawkish tone and the fresh Strait of Hormuz tanker strikes kept broader risk sentiment cautious, even with Bitcoin still up roughly 24% for the month.
signals.focus: worth watching whether this pause holds or turns into a deeper pullback if Fed hike odds keep climbing
